args.sql:
SELECT 
  (
    AVG(
      brakepadwearpercent + trackwearpercent + vehiclespeedkmh + engineloadpercent + tiremetrics->>'temperature_c'
    )
  ) AS vehicle_performance_score 
FROM 
  chassisandvehicle AS cv 
JOIN 
  engineandfluids AS ef 
ON 
  cv.chassisengref = ef.engineregistry;

parts.text:
The vehicle performance score is 250.06948010377752.

The score is calculated by taking the average of the following parameters:
- Brake pad wear percentage
- Track wear percentage
- Vehicle speed in km/h
- Engine load percentage
- Tire temperature in Celsius

The SQL query used to calculate the score is as follows:

```sql
SELECT 
  (
    AVG(
      brakepadwearpercent + trackwearpercent + vehiclespeedkmh + engineloadpercent + CAST(
        tiremetrics ->> 'temperature_c' AS NUMERIC
      )
    )
  ) AS vehicle_performance_score 
FROM 
  chassisandvehicle AS cv 
JOIN 
  engineandfluids AS ef 
ON 
  cv.chassisengref = ef.engineregistry;
```
